_doc: THE SIGNED RECORD FOR GS-3(a), THE FOOD PRESSURE CURE (chair ruling GS-3 on G-SEAMS S3, the owner's 'Do these next' of 2026-10-30, by delegation, vetoable; ODQ §934.101). Prepared and executed by build lane G1 from its committed tree (claude/ux-G1). One cause, six surfaces: the pulse's food pressure is computed from the causal food_security score, and that score now reads the food balance and the reserves instead of a sum of chain statuses. No generator golden moves (tests/property/generatorGoldenMaster.test.js green with the cure applied: causal state is derived on read, never persisted).
cause: GS-3(a) THE FOOD PRESSURE CURE. src/domain/causalState.js :: deriveFoodSecurity used to score 50 plus the SUM of the food chains' statuses (+8 stable, -8 strained, -15 scarce, ...), so a town that carried more chains read worse, reserves (r -0.24 with storage) and imports never counted, and the best-stocked tier read the worst (metropolis 30.2 on gen1000v2). src/domain/worldPulse/pressureModel.js computes FOOD PRESSURE as pressureFromScore(scores.food_security) and folds the same score into ECONOMY pressure, so the simulation pushed famine pressure hardest on the best-provisioned towns. The score now reads the conserved food ledger: 0.6 x the net balance (surplus minus deficit, clamped to +-50), 1.5 x the months in store (capped at 12), -20 under famine, the chains as a MEAN modifier (each weighted 1/n), conditions and the faith harvest channel unchanged. Over gen1000v2 (1000 towns): r against the net balance 0.393 -> 0.796, against the Overview word 0.378 -> 0.778, against storage -0.244 -> 0.270; metropolis mean 30.2 -> 50.7 and its mean food pressure 0.569 -> 0.278. No RNG stream forks (a pure derivation), but candidate-event admission is pressure-gated, so the pulse's drawn events shift downstream. ATTRIBUTION by single-variable revert: with HEAD's causalState.js and every other byte of the tree held, all six surfaces below reproduce their committed bytes (8 files, 50 tests green); with the cure, these corpus rows move: disposition-channels-dormancy-golden wr2-b|5|one_month (1 of 2); generosity-dormancy-golden gen-a, gen-b, gen-c (3 of 3); intel-trade-dormancy-golden it-b, it-c (2 of 3); momentum-dormancy-golden mo-a, mo-b, mo-c (3 of 3); worldpulse-seasons-golden seasons-golden-a|22|20, seasons-golden-b|0|26 (2 of 3); herald-knowledge-desk-golden the year's news (content hash and item count; the re-dealt year mints more items, so the manifest grows 387 -> 475 rows, measured by the door's own prediction refusal before any byte moved). The five dormancy manifests keep their key sets.
